title: TCS @1% applicable on all scrap sales
body: Per Section 206C(1H), TCS at 1% of sale consideration applies on all successful bids. TCS is collected with the final payment and reflected on the tax invoice.

title: Revised EMD refund timeline
body: EMD for unsuccessful bidders is now auto-released within 24 hours of catalogue close (previously 72 hours).

title: Lot 07 quantity revised
body: Indicative quantity for LOT-07 revised from 60 MT to 52 MT after re-measurement. Final quantity on weighment as always.

title: Lifting window extended
body: Due to yard congestion at Mancheswar Depot, the lifting window for all lots is extended by 5 working days.

title: Inspection: max 2 persons per firm
body: Yard security requires prior gate-pass booking. Maximum 2 representatives per bidding firm. Carry photo ID matching the booking.
